SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    ho.order_total,
    LTRIM(l.city, 'So') AS COL_ALIAS,
    TO_NUMBER('845') AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    SUBSTR(l.street_address, 5, 6) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    hc.cust_geo_location.SDO_POINT.Y AS GETYCOL,
    hc.account_mgr_id | w.location_id AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    w.wh_geo_location.SDO_POINT.X AS GETXCOL,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (ho.order_date - NUMTODSINTERVAL(22, 'DAY') - NUMTODSINTERVAL(14, 'HOUR') - NUMTODSINTERVAL(35, 'MINUTE'))) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    SUBSTR(hc.cust_email, 5, 3) AS COL_ALIAS_4
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US'
    AND l.postal_code LIKE '%26192%'
    AND w.warehouse_name NOT LIKE '%Southlake,%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    CAST(p.product_name AS VARCHAR2(20)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(35)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(40)),
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(8,2)),
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_name LIKE '%Screws%' THEN p.product_id END) AS COL_ALIAS,
    SUM(oi.quantity),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)),
    COUNT(o.order_id),
    w.warehouse_id,
    p.product_id,
    0.0,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(3))
FROM inventories i
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
INNER JOIN product_information p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN h_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    p.product_status = 'orderable'
    AND i.quantity_on_hand >= 50
GROUP BY 
    w.warehouse_id,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name

    COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt,
    p_type,
    CAST('2025-05-30' AS DATE),
    LPAD(p_type, 2, ' ') AS lpadcol,
    AVG(partsupp.ps_partkey) AS regr_avgx,  -- Approximation
    0.0,
    0.0,
    COVAR_POP(partsupp.ps_partkey, partsupp.ps_availqty) / COALESCE(NULLIF(VAR_POP(partsupp.ps_partkey), 0), 1) AS regr_slope,
    FROM_UNIXTIME(p_size) AS timestamp_val,  -- Assuming Unix timestamp
    CAST('2025-05-30' AS DATE) AS alias_date

  AND ps_suppkey NOT IN (
      SELECT s_suppkey
      FROM supplier
      WHERE s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'

UNION ALL

```sql
JOIN fclt_org_dlc_key b ON a.fclt_organization_key = b.fclt_organization_key
```

SELECT DISTINCT 
  CASE 
    WHEN library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL 
    THEN 
      CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) < -1 THEN 0
        WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) >= 23 THEN 9
        ELSE FLOOR((ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) + 1) * 8 / 24.0) + 1
      END
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS COL_ALIAS,
  MONTH(library_subject_offered.warehouse_load_date) AS COL_ALIAS,
  DATEADD(DAY, 1 - DATEPART(ISOWK, library_reserve_matrl_detail.warehouse_load_date), CAST(library_reserve_matrl_detail.warehouse_load_date AS DATE)) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(library_reserve_catalog.warehouse_load_date, 'MMM dd, yyyy', 'de-de'), '.', '') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  CONVERT(DATETIME, 'Nov 01, 1994', 107) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
  CASE 
    WHEN library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL 
    THEN 
      CASE 
        WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) < 8 THEN 0
        WHEN ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) >= 36 THEN 6
        ELSE FLOOR((ISNULL(library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students, 0) - 8) * 5 / 28.0) + 1
      END
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE('-382,13', '.', ''), ',', '.') AS FLOAT) * library_subject_offered.num_enrolled_students AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  NULL AS COL_ALIAS_4,
  CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE('4.24,16', '.', ''), ',', '.') AS FLOAT) * library_reserve_catalog.record_counter AS COL_ALIAS_5
FROM library_course_instructor 
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail ON library_course_instructor.library_course_instructor_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_course_instructor_key 
JOIN library_subject_offered ON library_subject_offered.library_subject_offered_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_subject_offered_key 
JOIN library_reserve_catalog ON library_reserve_catalog.library_reserve_catalog_key = library_reserve_matrl_detail.library_reserve_catalog_key
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  ( 
    SUM(CAST(w.location_id AS FLOAT)) 
    - ( 
        ( 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT) * CAST(w.location_id AS FLOAT))) 
          - (SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) * SUM(CAST(w.location_id AS FLOAT)) 
        ) 
        / 
        NULLIF( 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT) * CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT))) 
          - (SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) 
        , 0) 
      ) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) 
  ) / COUNT(*) AS COL_ALIAS,
  SUM(h.order_total) AS COL_ALIAS,
  NULL AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  NULL AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  NULL AS COL_ALIAS_2,
  h.customer_id AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  ( 
    SUM(CAST(h.customer_id AS FLOAT)) 
    - ( 
        ( 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT) * CAST(h.customer_id AS FLOAT))) 
          - (SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) * SUM(CAST(h.customer_id AS FLOAT)) 
        ) 
        / 
        NULLIF( 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT) * CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT))) 
          - (SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) 
        , 0) 
      ) * SUM(CAST(h.promotion_id AS FLOAT)) 
  ) / COUNT(*) AS COL_ALIAS_4,
  0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_5
FROM h_orders h 
INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id 
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey'
GROUP BY h.customer_id 
HAVING SUM(h.order_total) > 1000

    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    ho.order_total,

    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP('Oct 29, 2009, 02:49:31', 'Mon dd, YYYY, HH24:MI:SS')) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_DECIMAL(REPLACE(REPLACE('3.90,55', '.', ''), ',', '.')) * w.warehouse_id AS COL_ALIAS_1,

    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('Dec 13, 1972', 'Mon dd, YYYY')) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_4

    h_customers hc

    POSITION('le', schools.city) AS INSTR2COL,
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE('-4.168,8', '.', ''), ',', '.') AS DECIMAL(38,10)) * schools.longitude AS COL_ALIAS,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('Sep 12, 1981', 'Mon dd, YYYY')) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM schools.opendate) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_CHAR(schools.opendate, 'Mon dd, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CASE WHEN schools.opendate = TO_DATE('Aug 05, 2021', 'Mon dd, YYYY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS COL_ALIAS_2_CASE,
    TO_CHAR(schools.longitude, '9999999999.00') AS COL_ALIAS_2_FORMAT,  -- Simplified formatting
    MOD(schools.longitude, 2) AS REMAINDERCOL
FROM schools 
WHERE doc = '52'
AND county = 'Alameda'
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opendate) = 1980
AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM schools.closeddate + INTERVAL '20 years') - EXTRACT(DAY FROM schools.opendate) < 5

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name,
    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    ho.order_total,
    DATEADD(DAY, -7, ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CHARINDEX('9', l.postal_code, 3) AS INSTR3COL,
    DATEADD(MONTH, ho.order_id, ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    IIF(hc.cust_geo_location IS NOT NULL, ho.order_total, ho.order_status) AS NVL2COL,
    hc.cust_first_name + w.warehouse_name AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CASE 
        WHEN w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/Building') = 1 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS EXISTSNODECOL,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), ho.order_date, 120) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    CASE 
        WHEN w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/DockType') = 1 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS EXISTSNODECOL_0
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
    ho.order_total > 5000 
    AND l.country_id = 'US' 
    AND w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/DockType') = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(40)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(35)),
    CAST(
        (SUM(CAST(c.customer_id AS DECIMAL(30,10)) * CAST(c.customer_id AS DECIMAL(30,10))) 
        - (SUM(CAST(c.customer_id AS DECIMAL(30,10)) * SUM(CAST(c.customer_id AS DECIMAL(30,10))) 
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)
    AS DECIMAL(30,10)) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(NULL AS DATETIME),
    SUM(h.order_total) AS total_order_amount,
    CAST(NULL AS DATETIME),
    CAST(h.customer_id AS DECIMAL(8,2)),
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(55)),
    h.customer_id AS EXISTSNODECOL,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(30)),
    AVG(CAST(c.customer_id AS FLOAT)) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    h.customer_id AS EXISTSNODECOL_0
FROM h_orders h
INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey'

    hc.cust_last_name,
    hc.cust_email,
    w.warehouse_name,
    ho.order_total,
    CAST(ho.order_date AS DATE) AS COL_ALIAS,
    CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(ho.order_date) <= 6 THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', ho.order_date)
            ELSE DATEADD('YEAR', 1, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', ho.order_date))
        END 
        AS DATE
    ) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    w.location_id - 2 * ROUND(w.location_id / 2) AS REMAINDERCOL,
    CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN TIME(ho.order_date) >= '12:00:00' THEN DATEADD('DAY', 1, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ho.order_date))
            ELSE DATE_TRUNC('DAY', ho.order_date)
        END 
        AS DATE
    ) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('01-JUL-86', 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = English')) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_2,

SELECT 
    hc.cust_first_name AS first_name,
    w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse,
    CAST(w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/Building') AS INT) AS EXISTSNODECOL,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR, ho.order_date, 121) AS COL_ALIAS,
    DATEPART(DAY, ho.order_date) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    SUBSTRING(w.warehouse_name, 5, 8) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    l.street_address + l.state_province AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CAST(w.warehouse_spec.exist('/Warehouse/Docks') AS INT) AS EXISTSNODECOL_0,
    CASE 
        WHEN CHARINDEX('ab', l.street_address, 1) > 0 
        THEN CHARINDEX('ab', l.street_address, CHARINDEX('ab', l.street_address, 1) + 2) 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS INSTR4COL,
    FORMAT(ho.sales_rep_id, '$#,##0.00') AS COL_ALIAS_3
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
LEFT JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE ho.order_total > 10000
UNION ALL

    IF(DAY(t1.description) > 15,

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
    fr.room_full_name,
    b.building_name,
    b.building_street_address,
    fba.city,
    fba.state,
    fba.postal_code,
    fb.building_height,
    (date_trunc('MONTH', course_catalog_subject_offered.last_activity_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.total_units::DOUBLE PRECISION AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    TO_DATE(course_catalog_subject_offered.academic_year, 'YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM fr.warehouse_load_date) AS DAYCOL,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fb.warehouse_load_date) AS YEARCOL,
    TO_CHAR(course_catalog_subject_offered.last_activity_date, 'Mon DD, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.warehouse_load_date AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    (date_trunc('MONTH', b.warehouse_load_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS_4,
    course_catalog_subject_offered.warehouse_load_date - INTERVAL '3 days' AS ADDDATE_INTCOL 
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered 
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON meet_place = fclt_room_key 
JOIN fclt_building_address fba ON fba.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
JOIN buildings b ON b.building_key = fr.fclt_building_key 
WHERE department_name = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' 
  AND fba.address_purpose = 'STREET' 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 
    w.warehouse_name::VARCHAR(200), 
    hc.cust_email::VARCHAR(200), 
    hc.cust_last_name::VARCHAR(100), 
    hc.cust_first_name::VARCHAR(100), 
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fba.state
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fba.postal_code
    NULL::VARCHAR(100),  -- Aligns with fb.building_height
    NULL::DATE,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS
    ST_X(hc.cust_geo_location::geometry)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS GETXCOL, 
    NULL::DATE,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS_1
    CAST(ho.order_total AS INTEGER) AS DAYCOL,  -- Match first query's integer type
    hc.customer_id AS YEARCOL, 
    NULL::TEXT,          -- Aligns with COL_ALIAS_2
    (date_trunc('MONTH', ho.order_date) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH - 1 day')::date AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    DATE '2025-05-30' AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    ho.order_date::DATE AS ADDDATE_INTCOL  -- Cast to match first query's date type
FROM h_customers hc 
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id 
CROSS JOIN warehouses w 
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id 
WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 
  AND l.country_id = 'US'
```

WITH cte0 AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term 
         THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term,
    dept,
    subcnt,
    avgeqisub,
    sd.school_name AS school_name,
    ad.department_phone_number AS department_phone,
    TO_CHAR(sd.department_last_activity_date) col_0,
    INSTR(ad.department_phone_number, '4') col_1
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(term_code) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
           ELSE term_code END AS term_sort,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(term_code) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
           WHEN GROUPING(term_code) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
           ELSE term_code END AS term,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(term_code) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
           ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort,
      department_name AS dept,
      COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS subcnt,
      MIN(meet_time) AS mintime,
      AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0
               ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) 
          END) AS avgeqisub
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (term_code, department_name)
  ) tbltmp
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.department_name
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad ON sd.department_code = ad.sis_admin_department_code
),
cte1 AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(LEADING '09' FROM sd.dept_budget_code) col_2,
    ad.department_phone_number AS department_phone,
    avgeqisub,
    subcnt,
    sd.school_name AS school_name,
    dept,
    CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term 
         THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term,
    0.0 AS col_3
  FROM ( ... ) tbltmp  -- Same subquery as cte0
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.department_name
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad ON sd.department_code = ad.sis_admin_department_code
),
cte2 AS (
  SELECT
    ad.department_phone_number AS department_phone,
    sd.school_name AS school_name,
    - (tbltmp.subcnt + 1) col_4,  -- Bitwise NOT replacement
    avgeqisub,
    dept,
    CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term 
         THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term,
    NULL AS col_5,
    subcnt
  FROM ( ... ) tbltmp  -- Same subquery as cte0
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.department_name
  LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad ON sd.department_code = ad.sis_admin_department_code
),
cte3 AS (
  SELECT
    ad.department_phone_number AS department_phone,
    sd.school_name AS school_name,
    avgeqisub,
    subcnt,
    dept,
    CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term 
         THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term,
    NULL,
    0.0
  FROM ( ... ) tbltmp  -- Same subquery as cte0
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.department_name

pg: SELECT hc.cust_first_name AS first_name , w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse , ARRAY_LENGTH( hc.phone_numbers , 1 ) AS COL_ALIAS , TO_CHAR( ho.order_date , 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS COL_ALIAS_0 , STRPOS( w.warehouse_name , 'lak' ) AS STRPOSCOL , 0.0 , SUBSTRING( hc.cust_last_name FROM 0 FOR 7 ) AS SUBSTRINGCOL , TO_CHAR( w.location_id , 'FM99G999G999G999D000' ) AS COL_ALIAS_1 FROM h_customers hc INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id WHERE ho.order_total > 10000 AND EXTRACT( HOUR FROM ho.order_date + 'P3Y11M' :: interval ) - EXTRACT( HOUR FROM ho.order_date ) < 2 AND l.country_id ~ '.*US.*' AND l.street_address ILIKE '%2014 JABBERWOCKY RD%' AND hc.cust_first_name ILIKE '%MATTHIAS%' AND hc.cust_email ILIKE '%MATTHIAS.CRUISE@GROSBEAK.EXAMPLE.COM%' UNION ALL SELECT NULL , NULL , REGR_AVGX( h.sales_rep_id , c.credit_limit ) AS COL_ALIAS , NULL , SUM( h.order_total ) AS total_order_amount , h.customer_id , NULL AS SUBSTRINGCOL , NULL AS COL_ALIAS_0 FROM h_orders h INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_name = 'New Jersey' GROUP BY h.customer_id HAVING SUM( h.order_total ) > 1000

SELECT 
    w.warehouse_id, 
    p.product_id, 
    p.product_name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS recent_order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_ordered_quantity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_status LIKE '%orderable%' THEN i.quantity_on_hand END) COL_ALIAS,
    LTRIM(p.product_name, 'De') COL_ALIAS_0,
    AVG(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE('11/07/1987', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)) COL_ALIAS_1,
    LENGTH(p.product_name) COL_ALIAS_2,
    SUBSTR(p.product_name, 5, 1) COL_ALIAS_3,
    INSTR(p.product_name, '<Z.') STRPOSCOL,
    w.warehouse_id | p.product_id COL_ALIAS_4 
FROM inventories i
INNER JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
INNER JOIN product_information p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN h_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.product_status = 'orderable'
    AND i.quantity_on_hand >= 50 
    AND p.product_description LIKE '%Screws:%'
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.catalog_url, 'HTTP://WWW.SUPP-102074.COM/CAT/HW/P3140.HTML', 'i')
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, p.product_id, p.product_name
UNION ALL

    t2.numge1500 COL_ALIAS_3

WITH occurrences AS (
    SELECT 
        mld.moira_list_key, 
        mld.moira_list_owner_key, 
        COUNT(mld.moira_list_member) AS occurrences 
    FROM 
        moira_list_detail mld 
    GROUP BY 
        mld.moira_list_key, 
        mld.moira_list_owner_key
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    ml.moira_list_name, 
    mlo.owner, 
    ml.is_public, 
    ml.is_hidden, 
    o.occurrences, 
    TO_CHAR(mlo.warehouse_load_date, 'YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS, 
    TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(mlo.warehouse_load_date, 'DDD')) AS DAYOFYEARCOL, 
    0.0, 
    mlo.warehouse_load_date - 4 AS SUBDATECOL, 
    SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(mlo.warehouse_load_date, 'YYYY'), 2, 3) AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    0 AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    mlo.warehouse_load_date - 8 AS ADDDATE_INTCOL, 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM mlo.warehouse_load_date) AS DAYOFMONTHCOL 
FROM 
    occurrences o 
    JOIN moira_list ml ON o.moira_list_key = ml.moira_list_key 
    JOIN moira_list_owner mlo ON o.moira_list_owner_key = mlo.moira_list_owner_key 
WHERE 
    (o.occurrences = (SELECT MIN(occurrences) FROM occurrences)) 
    OR (
        o.occurrences = (SELECT MAX(occurrences) FROM occurrences) 
        AND o.moira_list_owner_key LIKE '%LISTvoyage-inspire%' 
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(o.moira_list_owner_key, '.*LISTvoyage-inspire.*') 
        AND ml.moira_list_key LIKE '%umbrella-umbrella%'
    ) 
UNION ALL 
SELECT DISTINCT 
    NULL, 
    NULL, 
    NULL, 
    NULL, 
    t2.fg & t2.alb AS COL_ALIAS, 
    NULL, 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.birthday) AS age, 
    t1.id, 
    DATE '2025-05-30' AS SUBDATECOL, 
    NULL AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    (t1.birthday - t1.description) AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    DATE '2025-05-30' AS ADDDATE_INTCOL, 
    t2.iga AS DAYOFMONTHCOL 
FROM 
    patient t1 
    INNER JOIN laboratory t2 ON t1.id = t2.id 
WHERE 
    t1.id IN (
        SELECT 
            id 
        FROM 
            laboratory 
        WHERE 
            hct >= 52 
        GROUP BY 
            id 
        HAVING 
            COUNT(id) >= 2
    )

SELECT DISTINCT
  s.term_code,
  s.subject_title,
  fr.room,
  fr.floor,
  b.building_key,
  b.building_street_address,
  fba.city,
  fba.state,
  fba.postal_code,
  s.form_type,
  s.num_enrolled_students,
  CASE WHEN s.warehouse_load_date = DATE '2024-12-19' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS COL_ALIAS,
  fr.latitude_wgs & fr.longitude_wgs AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  CAST(TRUNC(fr.area) AS INTEGER) << 9 AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  TO_CHAR(b.warehouse_load_date, 'Mon DD, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS_2,
  s.warehouse_load_date AS ADDDATE_INTCOL,
  fr.warehouse_load_date + INTERVAL '4' DAY AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  fr.warehouse_load_date - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS SUBDATECOL,
  b.warehouse_load_date - INTERVAL '2' MONTH AS SUBDATECOL_0,
  TRIM(TO_CHAR(s.warehouse_load_date, 'DAY')) AS DAYNAMECOL
FROM subject_offered s
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON s.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key
JOIN fclt_building_address fba ON fba.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key
JOIN buildings b ON fr.fclt_building_key = b.building_key
WHERE s.num_enrolled_students > 300
  AND fba.address_purpose = 'STREET'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fr.warehouse_load_date + (790272 / 1000000) * INTERVAL '1' SECOND) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.warehouse_load_date)
UNION ALL

  s.form_type,

  fba.state,
  fba.city,
  b.building_street_address,

  s.subject_title,

  0.0,

  0.0,

  DATE '2025-05-30',
  DATE '2025-05-30',
  DATE '2025-05-30',
  NULL
FROM subject_offered s
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON s.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key
JOIN fclt_building_address fba ON fba.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key
JOIN buildings b ON fr.fclt_building_key = b.building_key,
  user
WHERE s.num_enrolled_students > 300
  AND fba.address_purpose = 'STREET'
  AND displayname IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')

```sql
WITH subjectcounts AS (
  SELECT 
    term_code,
    fall_instructors,
    subject_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY term_code) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fall_instructors) AS experience 
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered 
  WHERE term_code = '2023FA'
)
SELECT 
  hc.cust_first_name,
  w.warehouse_name AS nearest_warehouse,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM ho.order_date) AS DAYCOL,
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM ho.order_date) AS DAYOFWEEKCOL,
  ST_X(w.wh_geo_location::geometry) AS GETXCOL,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ho.order_date) AS YEARCOL,
  DATE '2025-05-30',
  TO_CHAR(ho.order_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS COL_ALIAS,
  STRPOS(hc.cust_first_name, 'r') AS INSTRCOL
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE 
  ho.order_total > 5000 
  AND l.country_id = 'US'
  AND EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ho.order_date + INTERVAL '13 minute') - EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ho.order_date) < 5
  AND hc.cust_last_name ~ '.*Rampling.*'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
  ccso.fall_instructors,
  ccso.prerequisites,
  ccso.subject_title,
  at.term_description,
  sc.experience,
  sc.total_subjects,
  0,
  0.0,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(at.degree_year, 'YYYY'))::double precision,
  NULL::text,
  0
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
JOIN academic_terms at ON ccso.term_code = at.term_code
JOIN subjectcounts sc ON ccso.term_code = sc.term_code AND ccso.subject_id = sc.subject_id
WHERE ccso.term_code = '2023FA'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  CAST(CASE WHEN t2.closeddate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' ELSE 'well-finished' END AS VARCHAR(20)),
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(35)),
  CAST(NULL AS INTEGER),

  (t2.creaiondate::date - t2.lasactivitydate::date)::INTEGER,
  0.0::INTEGER,
  0.0::INTEGER,
  0.0::INTEGER,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2025-05-30')::DOUBLE PRECISION,
  NULL::TEXT,
  t2.acceptedanswerid
FROM comments AS t1
INNER JOIN posts AS t2 ON t1.postid = t2.id
WHERE t1.userid = 23853 AND t1.creationdate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0';
```

  SELECT 
    term_code,
    fall_instructors,
    subject_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY term_code) AS total_subjects,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fall_instructors) AS experience
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE term_code = '2023FA'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  at.term_description,
  ccso.subject_title,
  ccso.prerequisites,
  sc.total_subjects,
  ccso.fall_instructors,
  sc.experience,
  SUBSTR(ccso.comm_req_attribute_desc, 1, 2) AS COL_ALIAS,
  ccso.total_units | sc.total_subjects AS COL_ALIAS_0,

SELECT 
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice,
    SUM(l_quantity),
    ( (COUNT(*) * SUM(lineitem.l_linenumber * lineitem.l_extendedprice) - SUM(lineitem.l_linenumber) * SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice) ) 
        / 
        NULLIF( (COUNT(*) * SUM(lineitem.l_linenumber * lineitem.l_linenumber) - SUM(lineitem.l_linenumber) * SUM(lineitem.l_linenumber)), 0)
    ) AS COL_ALIAS,
    LPAD(c_name, 8) AS LPADCOL,
    DATE_FORMAT(o_orderdate, '%b %d, %Y') AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    DATE_FORMAT(o_orderdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    DAYOFYEAR(o_orderdate) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    RPAD(c_name, 10) AS RPADCOL,
    '2025-05-30' AS COL_ALIAS_3
FROM 
    tpch_customer,
    orders,
    lineitem
WHERE 
    o_orderkey IN (
        SELECT l_orderkey
        FROM lineitem
        GROUP BY l_orderkey
        HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300
    )
    AND c_custkey = o_custkey
    AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
    AND lineitem.l_returnflag = ' '
GROUP BY 
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice,
    SUM(l_quantity),
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(l_extendedprice * l_linenumber) - SUM(l_extendedprice) * SUM(l_linenumber))
    / (COUNT(*) * SUM(l_linenumber * l_linenumber) - SUM(l_linenumber) * SUM(l_linenumber)) AS COL_ALIAS,
    LPAD(c_name, 8, ' ') AS LPADCOL,
    DATE_FORMAT(o_orderdate, '%b %d, %Y') AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    DATE_FORMAT(o_orderdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    DAYOFYEAR(o_orderdate) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    RPAD(c_name, 10, ' ') AS RPADCOL,
    '2025-05-30' AS COL_ALIAS_3
FROM tpch_customer, orders, lineitem 
WHERE o_orderkey IN (
    SELECT l_orderkey 
    FROM lineitem 
    GROUP BY l_orderkey 
    HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300
) 
AND c_custkey = o_custkey 
AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey 
AND l_returnflag LIKE '% %' 
GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice
UNION ALL 
SELECT DISTINCT 
    building_name, 
    num_students, 
    CAST(0.0 AS SIGNED), 
    '2025-05-30', 
    CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)), 
    CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)), 
    CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)), 
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR), 
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR), 
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR), 
    CAST(0.0 AS SIGNED), 
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR), 
    STR_TO_DATE(fclt_building.date_built, '%m/%d/%Y') 
FROM (
    SELECT fclt_building_key, COUNT(DISTINCT full_name) AS num_students 
    FROM fclt_rooms 
    JOIN mit_student_directory ON office_location = building_room 
    GROUP BY fclt_building_key

SELECT
    fb.building_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id),
    MAX(CASE WHEN fb.building_name LIKE '%BUILDING E62%' COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ILIKECOL,
    MAX(CHARINDEX(fb.building_name, fb.fclt_building_key)) AS POSITIONCOL,
    (SUM(1.0 * fr.longitude_wgs * fr.northing_spcs) - (SUM(1.0 * fr.longitude_wgs) * SUM(1.0 * fr.northing_spcs) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fr.northing_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fr.northing_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS,
    SUM(1.0 * fb.northing_y_spcs * ccso.total_units) - (SUM(1.0 * fb.northing_y_spcs) * SUM(1.0 * ccso.total_units) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.northing_y_spcs IS NOT NULL AND ccso.total_units IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs * fb.easting_x_spcs) - (SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs) * SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.assignable_area IS NOT NULL AND fb.easting_x_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    SUM(1.0 * fr.latitude_wgs * fb.num_of_rooms) - (SUM(1.0 * fr.latitude_wgs) * SUM(1.0 * fb.num_of_rooms) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.latitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fb.num_of_rooms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fb.fclt_building_key LIKE '%16%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TRUECOL,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LEFT(fb.fclt_building_key, LEN(fb.building_name)) = fb.building_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STARTSWITHCOL,
    SUM(1.0 * fb.num_of_rooms * fb.num_of_rooms) - (SUM(1.0 * fb.num_of_rooms) * SUM(1.0 * fb.num_of_rooms) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.num_of_rooms IS NOT NULL AND fr.easting_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    MAX(CASE WHEN RIGHT(fb.fclt_building_key, LEN(fb.building_name)) = fb.building_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ENDSWITHCOL
FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccso ON ccc.subject_id = ccso.subject_id
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON ccso.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key

WITH subjectsbyterm AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.subject_id,
    cc.subject_title,
    cc.total_units,
    cc.department_name,
    CASE 
      WHEN cc.term_code LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Fall'
      WHEN cc.term_code LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Spring'
    END AS offered_term,
    at.term_description AS term_description,
    sd.school_name,
    scd.course_level,
    cc.fall_instructors,
    cc.spring_instructors,
    DATE(cc.warehouse_load_date, '+' || CAST(cc.total_units AS INTEGER) || ' months') AS COL_ALIAS,
    IFNULL(cc.school_wide_electives, cc.meet_time) AS NVLCOL,
    DATE(cc.warehouse_load_date, '+' || CAST(cc.lecture_units AS INTEGER) || ' days') AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', at.term_end_date) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CASE 
      WHEN at.last_day_of_final_exam IS NOT NULL THEN cc.gir_attribute_desc
      ELSE cc.joint_subjects
    END AS NVL2COL,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    DATE(at.drop_date, 'start of month') AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_4,
    CASE 
      WHEN sd.department_code IS NULL OR sd.is_degree_granting IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN sd.department_code LIKE sd.is_degree_granting || '%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS STARTSWITHCOL,
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_5,
    CASE 
      WHEN cc.total_units = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(cc.lecture_units AS REAL) / cc.total_units
    END AS DIV0COL
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  JOIN academic_terms at ON cc.term_code = at.term_code
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON cc.department_code = sd.department_code
  LEFT JOIN sis_course_description scd ON cc.subject_code = scd.course
  WHERE cc.is_offered_this_year = 'Y'
    AND (cc.term_code LIKE '%FA' OR cc.term_code LIKE '%SP')
),
subjectsaggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    subject_id,
    subject_title,
    department_name,
    school_name,
    course_level,
    total_units,
    offered_term,
    term_description,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fall_instructors) AS num_fall_instructors,

WITH subjectsbyterm AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.subject_id, 
    cc.subject_title, 
    cc.total_units, 
    cc.department_name, 
    CASE 
      WHEN cc.term_code LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Fall' 
      WHEN cc.term_code LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Spring' 
    END AS offered_term, 
    at.term_description AS term_description, 
    sd.school_name, 
    scd.course_level, 
    cc.fall_instructors, 
    cc.spring_instructors, 
    DATE(cc.warehouse_load_date, CAST(cc.total_units || ' months') AS COL_ALIAS, 
    COALESCE(cc.school_wide_electives, cc.meet_time) AS NVLCOL, 
    DATE(cc.warehouse_load_date, CAST(cc.lecture_units || ' days') AS COL_ALIAS_0, 
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', at.term_end_date) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_1, 
    CASE 
      WHEN at.last_day_of_final_exam IS NOT NULL THEN cc.gir_attribute_desc 
      ELSE cc.joint_subjects 
    END AS NVL2COL, 
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_2, 
    DATE(at.drop_date, 'start of month') AS COL_ALIAS_3, 
    0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_4, 
    DATE(at.registration_day, 'start of month') AS COL_ALIAS_5, 
    CAST(STRFTIME('%m', at.last_day_of_classes) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_6, 
    CAST(STRFTIME('%m', at.registration_day) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_7 
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc 
  JOIN academic_terms at ON cc.term_code = at.term_code 
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd ON cc.department_code = sd.department_code 
  LEFT JOIN sis_course_description scd ON cc.subject_code = scd.course 
  WHERE cc.is_offered_this_year = 'Y' 
    AND (cc.term_code LIKE '%FA' OR cc.term_code LIKE '%SP')
), 
subjectsaggregated AS (

SELECT
  CASE WHEN t3.lac IS NOT NULL THEN t2.sc170 ELSE t2.hct END AS NVL2COL,
  DATE(t1.birthday, 'start of month') AS COL_ALIAS,
  DATE(t1.birthday, 'start of year') AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%d', t1.description) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  DATE(t1.description, '+' || CAST(CAST(t2.fg AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) || ' months') AS COL_ALIAS_2,
  CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', t1.description) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
  CASE WHEN t1.admission LIKE t2.crp || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS STARTSWITHCOL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_4,
  0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_5,
  0.0 AS COL_ALIAS_6
FROM patient t1
INNER JOIN laboratory t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
INNER JOIN examination t3 ON t3.id = t2.id
WHERE t2.igg >= 2000
UNION ALL
SELECT
  AVG(partsupp.ps_availqty) AS COL_ALIAS,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT partsupp.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt,
  NULL,
  p_size,
  NULL,
  p_type,
  p_brand,
  (SUM(partsupp.ps_partkey * partsupp.ps_partkey) - (SUM(partsupp.ps_partkey) * SUM(partsupp.ps_partkey)) / COUNT(partsupp.ps_partkey) AS COL_ALIAS_0,

  (SUM(partsupp.ps_suppkey * partsupp.ps_suppkey) - (SUM(partsupp.ps_suppkey) * SUM(partsupp.ps_suppkey)) / COUNT(partsupp.ps_suppkey) AS COL_ALIAS_2
FROM partsupp
JOIN part ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey
WHERE p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
  AND p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
  AND p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
  AND ps_suppkey NOT IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%')
GROUP BY p_brand, p_type, p_size

SELECT 
    fb.building_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id),
    CASE WHEN LOWER(fb.building_name) LIKE '%building e62%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ILIKECOL,
    CHARINDEX(fb.building_name, fb.fclt_building_key) AS POSITIONCOL,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fr.northing_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 
         THEN (SUM(1.0 * fr.longitude_wgs * fr.northing_spcs) - (SUM(1.0 * fr.longitude_wgs) * SUM(1.0 * fr.northing_spcs) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fr.northing_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)) 
              / COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fr.northing_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.northing_y_spcs IS NOT NULL AND ccso.total_units IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 
         THEN SUM(1.0 * fb.northing_y_spcs * ccso.total_units) - (SUM(1.0 * fb.northing_y_spcs) * SUM(1.0 * ccso.total_units)) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.northing_y_spcs IS NOT NULL AND ccso.total_units IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_0,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.assignable_area IS NOT NULL AND fb.easting_x_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 
         THEN SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs * fb.easting_x_spcs) - (SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs) * SUM(1.0 * fb.easting_x_spcs)) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.assignable_area IS NOT NULL AND fb.easting_x_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.latitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fb.num_of_rooms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 
         THEN SUM(1.0 * fr.latitude_wgs * fb.num_of_rooms) - (SUM(1.0 * fr.latitude_wgs) * SUM(1.0 * fb.num_of_rooms)) / COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.latitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fb.num_of_rooms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS COL_ALIAS_2,
    CASE WHEN fb.fclt_building_key LIKE '%16%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TRUECOL,
    CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(fb.building_name, fb.fclt_building_key) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS STARTSWITHCOL,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.total_units IS NOT NULL AND fb.longitude_wgs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS COL_ALIAS_3,
    CASE 
        WHEN fb.building_name IS NULL OR fb.fclt_building_key IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN LEN(fb.building_name) < LEN(fb.fclt_building_key) THEN 0
        WHEN RIGHT(fb.building_name, LEN(fb.fclt_building_key)) = fb.fclt_building_key THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS ENDSWITHCOL
FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccso ON ccc.subject_id = ccso.subject_id
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON ccso.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key
JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key
GROUP BY fb.fclt_building_key, fb.building_name

SELECT
  fb.building_name,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.subject_id) AS FLOAT),
  CASE WHEN fb.building_name LIKE '%BUILDING E62%' COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ILIKECOL,
  CHARINDEX(fb.building_name, fb.fclt_building_key) AS POSITIONCOL,
  COVAR_POP(CAST(fr.longitude_wgs AS FLOAT), CAST(fr.northing_spcs AS FLOAT)) AS COL_ALIAS,
  (SUM(fb.northing_y_spcs * ccso.total_units) - (SUM(fb.northing_y_spcs) * SUM(ccso.total_units)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.northing_y_spcs IS NOT NULL AND ccso.total_units IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_0,
  (SUM(fb.easting_x_spcs * fb.easting_x_spcs) - (SUM(fb.easting_x_spcs) * SUM(fb.easting_x_spcs)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.assignable_area IS NOT NULL AND fb.easting_x_spcs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
  (SUM(fr.latitude_wgs * fb.num_of_rooms) - (SUM(fr.latitude_wgs) * SUM(fb.num_of_rooms)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN fr.latitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fb.num_of_rooms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS COL_ALIAS_2,
  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(fb.fclt_building_key, fb.building_name) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CONTAINSCOL,
  ISNULL(fb.fclt_building_key, fb.building_name) AS NVLCOL,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fb.latitude_wgs IS NOT NULL AND fb.non_assignable_area IS NOT NULL THEN fb.latitude_wgs END) AS COL_ALIAS_3
FROM cis_course_catalog ccc
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered ccso ON ccc.subject_id = ccso.subject_id
JOIN fclt_rooms fr ON ccso.meet_place = fr.fclt_room_key
JOIN fclt_building fb ON fb.fclt_building_key = fr.fclt_building_key
GROUP BY fb.fclt_building_key, fb.building_name
UNION ALL

    avgscrwrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrwrite DESC NULLS LAST) AS writingscorerank,

    LEAST(t1.longitude, t2.avgscrmath, t2.avgscrwrite) AS MIN2COL,

    IFF(t1.soctype LIKE '%High%', t1.gsserved, t1.district) AS IIFCOL,

SELECT
    t1.charternum,
    t2.avgscrwrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.avgscrwrite DESC NULLS LAST) AS writingscorerank,
    TO_CHAR(DATEADD(day, 1, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(t1.lastupdate)), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DATETIME1COL,
    CASE WHEN t1.admlname3 LIKE '%WOODRUFF%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LIKECOL,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(t1.admfname1, '^DANIEL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS GLOBCOL,
    TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY') AS STRFTIME2COL,
    GREATEST(t1.latitude, t1.longitude) AS MAXCOL,
    GREATEST(t1.longitude, t1.latitude, t2.avgscrread) AS MAX2COL,
    LEAST(t1.latitude, t2.avgscrread, t1.longitude) AS MIN2COL,
    LEAST(t1.latitude, t2.avgscrread, t2.avgscrmath) AS MIN2COL_0,
    CAST(EXTRACT(epoch_second FROM TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(t1.opendate)) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS
FROM schools t1
INNER JOIN satscores t2 ON t1.cdscode = t2.cds
WHERE t2.avgscrwrite > 499

    AND REGEXP_LIKE(t1.admlname1, '^ABSTON')
UNION ALL

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS first_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS last_name,

    CAST(DATEDIFF('second', '1970-01-01'::TIMESTAMP, TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(lineitem.l_commitdate)) AS INTEGER) AS COL_ALIAS_1,
    TO_CHAR(DATEADD(hour, 3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS STRFTIME4COL,

    GREATEST(lineitem.l_linenumber, part.p_partkey) AS MAXCOL_0
FROM lineitem, part
WHERE (
    (part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey AND part.p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND part.p_container IN ('SM CASE', 'SM BOX', 'SM PACK', 'SM PKG') AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 11 AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON')

    OR
    (part.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey AND part.p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND part.p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') AND lineitem.l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30 AND part.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND lineitem.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG') AND lineitem.l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON')

    w.warehouse_name,
